AurelionSol|mid.identity: Magic damage mage who scales endlessly thanks to Stardust (passive Cosmic Creator): he collects it by killing minions with Singularity (E), hitting champions and getting takedowns, and every stack upgrades his abilities. Breath of Light (Q) channels a continuous breath, Astral Flight (W) flies him over a long distance, Singularity (E) pulls enemies toward its center, and Falling Star (R) knocks up, then becomes The Skies Descend once he has gathered enough Stardust.
AurelionSol|mid.playstyle: Pure scaling mage: in lane, he stacks; in the mid and late game, he becomes a huge area threat. He's weak against assassins who dive him early (Yone, Fizz, Zed).
AurelionSol|mid.early_game: Stack Stardust by killing minions inside your Singularity and hitting your opponent with Q. Avoid all-ins against assassins: you're fragile. Keep W to escape.
AurelionSol|mid.level_1: Singularity (E) first on the most common path. It executes weak minions in its center and gives Stardust.
AurelionSol|mid.level_2: Breath of Light (Q). Channel the breath on your opponent to poke and stack.
AurelionSol|mid.level_3: Astral Flight (W). Your escape and roaming tool: you can fly over walls.
AurelionSol|mid.level_6: Falling Star: an area knock-up. Combo: E (pull) → R → Q. Once you've gathered enough Stardust, it becomes The Skies Descend (bigger area).
power_spikes: Stardust stacks: bigger and stronger abilities.
Late game: one of the most devastating mages.
AurelionSol|mid.lane_plan: Stack Stardust by killing minions with E and hitting your opponent with Q. Keep the wave in the middle or near you against assassins. Roam with W when your wave is pushed. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you reset quickly to keep stacking.
AurelionSol|mid.trading: Basic trade: Q (breath) on your opponent when they come to last hit. Long trade: E → R → Q. Engage when your opponent is pulled by E; give up on it against assassins who dive you.
threats: Assassins who dive you (Yone, Fizz, Zed, Kassadin).
mistakes: Using W to poke and not having it to escape.
Channeling Q for too long within an assassin's range.

matchup_notes.Yasuo: Keep him at range with E and Q.
matchup_notes.Viktor: Scale faster than him by stacking.
matchup_notes.Yone: He dives you: keep W to escape and farm carefully.
matchup_notes.Fizz: He dodges your abilities and bursts you: farm under your tower.

AurelionSol|mid.mid_game: Keep stacking, join objectives and control areas with E and R.
AurelionSol|mid.late_game: Zone mage: E to pull, R to knock up, Q to burn. Stay behind your frontline.
AurelionSol|mid.ahead: Stack faster, take objectives and dominate teamfights.
AurelionSol|mid.behind: Keep stacking safely: your late game makes up for being behind.
AurelionSol|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to stack Stardust and dominate teamfights late in the game.
AurelionSol|mid.final_tip: Kill minions in the center of your Singularity: every execute grants Stardust.
